notes: PostgreSQL stores dashboards and configuration instead of the embedded H2 file, which is unsuitable for production and unsafe to copy while running.
The measured JVM memory floor is 2g: the default 512m ceiling caused startup crashes.
Everything persistent lives in the database volume; the site URL is configured through the setup wizard.
